user.title: Weekly Menu
user.description: Adds a lunch and dinner planner with its own sidebar panel, a dashboard card and the “Lunch today” and “Dinner today” sensors. With Despensa and Cesta installed you can check what the menu is missing and add it to the shopping list.

generate.name: Generate menu
generate.description: Generates a week of lunches and dinners from your recipes (keeps pinned dishes and free slots).

week.name: Week
week.description: “current”, “next”, a date (2026-10-12) or an ISO week (2026-W42).

check_ingredients.name: Check ingredients
check_ingredients.description: Compares the menu's ingredients with Despensa and returns what is missing. Optionally adds it to Cesta.

week.name: Week
week.description: “current”, “next”, a date or an ISO week.

add_to_cesta.name: Add to Cesta
add_to_cesta.description: Adds what is missing to the Cesta shopping list.

get_menu.name: Get menu
get_menu.description: Returns the menu for a week or a day, with a text ready for notifications.

week.name: Week
week.description: “current”, “next”, a date or an ISO week.

day.name: Day
day.description: “today”, “tomorrow”, a weekday or a date. If set, only that day is returned.
